interface.shortDescription: Methodology-grounded B2B sales playbook configurator and call inspection system for sales teams.
interface.longDescription: Configure a B2B sales methodology (Sandler, Force Management, MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Value-Based Selling, Challenger, Gap Selling, Science of Sales, Blair Enns Four Conversations, Jonathan Stark Why Conversation) and inspect call transcripts for rep posture, positioning adherence, deal-quality signals beyond CRM stages, and compounding revenue-machine improvements.
